classification_evidence.decision: META is dilution-clear. The only registration statement in the window is the April 30, 2026 S-3ASR (Reg. No. 333-295425), and its filing-fee table registers a single class — "Debt / Debt Securities" under Rule 457(r) — with a cover page reading simply "Debt Securities". It is therefore NOT a mixed shelf: it carries no common-stock, warrant, preferred, purchase-contract or unit capacity, so the project's "mixed equity shelf blocks" rule is not triggered. The two 424B2 supplements are the preliminary and the final version of the same takedown off that shelf: $25,000,000,000 of straight senior notes across six tranches (4.550% 2031, 4.875% 2033, 5.250% 2036, 6.200% 2046, 6.300% 2056, 6.450% 2066), unsecured, ranking pari passu with other senior unsecured debt, with optional redemption at make-whole prices and no conversion or exchange feature into common stock. Nothing in the window registers or sells new common equity, no ATM programme, no warrants, no convertible. The financing is large but it is pure leverage, not share count. Verdict: no dilution block.

primaries.quote: Prospectus cover: "Meta Platforms, Inc. / Debt Securities / Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”) may, from time to time, offer and sell debt securities in one or more series." and "This prospectus may not be used to offer and sell debt securities unless accompanied by a prospectus supplement." The EX-FILING FEES table (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000119312526194008/d102985dexfilingfees.htm) registers exactly one line: Security Type "Debt", Security Class Title "Debt Securities", Rule 457(r). No common stock, warrant, preferred, purchase-contract or unit class is registered; the only occurrence of "common stock" in the document is descriptive ("Our Class A common stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “META.”"). This is a debt-only shelf, not a mixed shelf.

Preliminary prospectus supplement ("SUBJECT TO COMPLETION, APRIL 30, 2026", Registration No. 333-295425) to the April 30, 2026 debt shelf: "We are offering $ of our % senior notes due 20 (the “20 notes”) ... and $ of our % senior notes due 20 ... (the “notes”)." "The notes will be our unsecured obligations and will rank equally with all of our other unsecured senior indebtedness from time to time outstanding." Security offered = six series of unsecured senior notes, non-convertible; size left blank at this preliminary stage. No common equity, no conversion feature, no warrants.

Final pricing supplement, Registration No. 333-295425: "$25,000,000,000 / Meta Platforms, Inc. / $3,000,000,000 4.550% Senior Notes due 2031 / $2,000,000,000 4.875% Senior Notes due 2033 / $6,000,000,000 5.250% Senior Notes due 2036 / $4,000,000,000 6.200% Senior Notes due 2046 / $6,000,000,000 6.300% Senior Notes due 2056 / $4,000,000,000 6.450% Senior Notes due 2066". "The notes will be our unsecured obligations and will rank equally with all of our other unsecured senior indebtedness from time to time outstanding." Security offered = $25bn of straight, non-convertible senior notes in six tranches.

signals.thesis: Meta gagne 2,71 % sur la séance et 7,92 % sur cinq séances, dans le secteur le mieux orienté du jour. Attention au vocabulaire : le champ qui compte quinze séances mesure une amplitude quotidienne contenue, pas une base plate. Sur ces quinze séances le titre est passé de 549,90 à 665,60 dollars, soit +21,04 % en escalier presque monotone. C'est donc une continuation de tendance à volatilité maîtrisée, pas une sortie de consolidation — et on paie une force déjà installée. Le RSI est à 70,8, tout près du plafond de 72 que la politique s'impose, et l'extension au-dessus de la moyenne mobile 50 atteint 10,95 %. Côté bilan, le seul dépôt d'offre de la fenêtre est un programme de dette : la déclaration d'avril n'enregistre qu'une seule classe de titres, « Debt Securities », et le tirage de 25 milliards de dollars s'est fait en six tranches d'obligations senior non convertibles. Levier, pas dilution. Supplément définitif du 1er mai 2026.
signals.invalidation: Une clôture sous le plus bas de la séance de référence casse la sortie de consolidation : le mouvement se relit alors comme un faux départ sur volume de rotation sectorielle, et non comme une tendance. Le stop dur reste actif pendant la séance.

signals.name: Qualcomm

earnings_forward_evidence.result: prochaine publication 2026-10-29 — hors fenêtre ±3 j et au-delà de l'horizon de 10 séances

signals.dilution_scope: Dépôts SEC officiels revus du 2026-03-18 au 2026-09-14 ; dette classée séparément des offres d’actions.

classification_evidence.decision: QCOM is dilution-clear under the stated taxonomy, with one honest caveat worth stating out loud. Two of the three filings are plain S-8s: 24,000,000 shares added to the shareholder-approved Amended and Restated 2023 LTIP (March 19), and 1,438,756 shares covering Modular Inc options and restricted stock assumed and rolled into that same LTIP after the July 28 merger closed (July 31) — both are employee benefit-plan registrations, not capital raises. The third, the 424B7 filed off shelf 333-283035, is a selling-stockholder resale: up to 17,826,566 shares of common stock issued (and issuable) as Modular merger consideration, with the document stating twice that Qualcomm receives no proceeds. Under the classification rules that is "resale", and no filing in the window is "equity" or "unknown", so the candidate is not blocked. The caveat: these are genuinely new shares from Qualcomm's point of view — they were minted to pay for an acquisition, not sold for cash — so share count does rise by roughly 17.8m (about 1.6% of the ~1.1bn shares outstanding) plus up to 1.4m more from assumed awards. That is M&A consideration and employee comp, not a financing overhang, and the resale prospectus creates supply into the market rather than issuer proceeds. Verdict: no dilution block, but flag the ~19m-share merger/comp issuance as a known, bounded supply event rather than pretending nothing was issued.

The Restated 2023 LTIP was approved by the stockholders of the Company on March 17, 2026." signals.thesis: La séance de lundi mérite d'être lue en entier, pas à la clôture. Qualcomm a ouvert à 170,78 dollars, soit −6,15 % sur la clôture de la veille, est descendu à 170,51, puis a repris la totalité de son écart pour finir à 180,15, en baisse de 1,00 % seulement. Amplitude de la séance : 6,56 %, la plus large du panier. Ce n'est pas un titre qui a résisté au calme ; c'est un titre qui a été vendu avec son secteur puis racheté dans la journée. L'entrée publiée est au sommet de ce retournement, et le stop à 168,86 dollars se situe sous le plus bas de la séance — une répétition du même mouvement le déclencherait. L'extension au-dessus de la moyenne mobile 50 n'est que de 4,73 %, ce qui laisse de la place. Le supplément de juillet est une revente d'actionnaires reçus en paiement de l'acquisition de Modular : jusqu'à 17,8 millions d'actions déjà émises changent de mains, et le prospectus précise deux fois que l'émetteur n'en retire aucun produit. Supplément du 31 juillet 2026.
signals.invalidation: Une clôture sous le plus bas de la séance de référence signifie que la résistance du titre à la purge sectorielle n'a tenu qu'une séance. L'écart relatif se referme alors, et la raison d'être de la ligne disparaît. Le stop dur reste actif pendant la séance.

classification_evidence.decision: Dilution-clear for the window. The 2026-07-30 S-8 is a plain General-Instruction-E top-up of the shareholder-approved 2013 Incentive Award Plan (5,367,243 shares); the extracted text contains no occurrence of proceeds, selling securityholder, reoffer, resale or underwriting, so nothing in the document offers shares for issuer cash proceeds. I enumerated all 31 Rexford filings on EDGAR between 2026-03-18 and 2026-09-14: nothing but 8-K, 10-Q, DEF 14A/ARS, Forms 3/4/144 and 13G/A — no S-3, no S-3ASR, no 424B, no ATM supplement, no warrant or convertible. The only item-1.01 event in the window is the 2026-08-18 8-K (accession 0001571283-26-000048), which is a disposition, not an issuance: 'the Operating Partnership agreed to sell to the Buyer a portfolio of 22 industrial properties (the "Portfolio") for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1.2 billion ... payable in cash at the closing' — cash IN from an asset sale, the opposite of equity dilution. Honest caveat, not a window finding: Rexford is an equity REIT that maintains an automatic shelf (S-3ASR filed 2023-10-23, accession 0001193125-23-260774) under which it has historically run ATM/forward-sale equity programmes; its last such prospectus supplement was a 424B5 on 2025-07-22, i.e. roughly eight months before the window opens. The standing shelf means future ATM issuance is always available to REXR, but no filing inside 2026-03-18..2026-09-14 constitutes an equity offering, ATM, warrant or convertible. REXR passes the dilution gate.

classification_evidence.decision: Dilution-clear for the window, with the largest caveat of the three. The 2026-05-20 S-8 is an evergreen top-up of the 2021 Equity Incentive Plan (34,796,916 shares, ~$1.0bn at the $29.17 Rule 457(c) reference price) — a big number in absolute terms, but it is compensation reserve, not a cash raise: the primary contains no 'proceeds', 'selling securityholder', 'reoffer', 'resale' or 'underwriting' language at all, and Part I is the standard Rule 428(b)(1) participant-delivery note. I walked all 83 Roivant filings on EDGAR between 2026-03-18 and 2026-09-14: 45 Form 4s, 21 Form 144/144A, 4 13G/A, 6 8-Ks, 10-K, 10-Q, DEF 14A/DEFA14A/ARS, one 8-K/A, and this S-8. No S-1, no S-3, no 424B, no ATM supplement, no warrant or convertible issuance. I opened the three 8-Ks that could plausibly have carried a financing: the 2026-03-23 8-K/A item 1.01 is the Genevant/Arbutus-Moderna patent litigation 'Settlement Agreement, dated March 3, 2026', not a securities purchase agreement; the 2026-08-28 item 8.01 is the LISRAYA (brepocitinib) FDA-approval investor presentation; the 2026-09-08 and 2026-08-27 item 7.01s are the PHocus mosliciguat readout and the LISRAYA NDA approval press releases. All clinical/legal, none an offering. Honest caveat, not a window finding: Roivant filed an automatic shelf S-3ASR on 2025-10-03 (accession 0001140361-25-037241), outside the window, which as a well-known-seasoned-issuer shelf includes common-equity capacity — so a follow-on or ATM could be launched at any time off it, and this is a biotech with a history of 424B5 equity raises (2022-2023). But nothing inside 2026-03-18..2026-09-14 constitutes an issuer equity offering, ATM, warrant or convertible. ROIV passes the dilution gate on filed evidence; the live shelf is a forward risk to size for, not a blocking fact.

signals.thesis: Les +17,43 % sur cinq séances sont exacts, la lecture d'accélération ne l'est pas. Tout le mouvement tient dans une seule séance : le 8 septembre, ouverture à 39,98 dollars contre 34,93 de clôture la veille, soit un saut de 14,5 % à l'ouverture, clôture à 41,48 sur 24,7 millions d'actions — environ quatre fois le volume des séances voisines. Les quatre séances suivantes font 41,81, 40,94, 40,82 puis 41,02 : le titre digère, il n'accélère pas. On achète donc une consolidation au-dessus d'un gap d'événement, ce qui est une figure différente et un risque différent — le gap n'a pas été comblé, mais rien ne dit qu'il ne le sera pas. Deux réserves : l'extension au-dessus de la moyenne mobile 50 atteint 14,51 %, et surtout la société garde ouverte une déclaration automatique déposée en octobre 2025, hors fenêtre de contrôle, qui autorise une émission d'actions à tout moment. L'inscription de mai, elle, porte sur 34,8 millions d'actions de plan d'intéressement, ce qui n'est pas une levée. Motif de dimensionner petit, pas motif de rejet.
signals.invalidation: Sous le plus bas de la séance de référence, l'accélération se retourne : sur une biotech sans flux de trésorerie, un momentum cassé se paie vite et l'ouverture suivante peut se faire loin du stop. Le stop dur reste actif pendant la séance.

signals.dilution_scope: Dépôts SEC officiels revus du 2026-03-18 au 2026-09-14 ; dette classée séparément des offres d’actions.

classification_evidence.decision: STT is dilution-clear. All four filings are prospectus supplements off the same pre-existing shelf, Registration no. 333-288196 (base prospectus dated June 20, 2025 — outside the 180-day window, and therefore not itself a filing under review here). They are two takedowns, each appearing twice as preliminary then final. Takedown one: $1.5bn of senior unsecured notes — $800m fixed-to-floating due 2032 (4.558% then SOFR+0.914%) and $700m due 2037 (5.094% then SOFR+1.201%), ranking equally with other senior unsecured debt, with no conversion or exchange feature. Takedown two: $500m of depositary shares representing 1/100th interests in the 6.350% Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series L (500,000 depositary shares at $1,000, $497m net proceeds). The preferred is the only item that could plausibly reach common equity, and both the preliminary and the final supplement state flatly that it "will not be convertible into, or exchangeable for, shares of any other class or series of stock or other securities of State Street." That places it squarely in the "preferred with no common-equity capacity" bucket. No common stock, no ATM, no warrants, no convertible anywhere in the window — this is ordinary G-SIB funding and AT1-style capital management. Verdict: no dilution block.

primaries.quote: Preliminary prospectus supplement ("SUBJECT TO COMPLETION, DATED APRIL 21, 2026", Registration no. 333-288196): "This is an offering of $ aggregate principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2032 (the “2032 notes”) and $ aggregate principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2037 (the “2037 notes” and, together with the 2032 notes, the “notes”) of State Street Corporation." "The notes are unsecured and will rank equally with all other existing and future senior unsecured indebtedness of State Street." Security offered = two series of SOFR-linked fixed-to-floating senior notes; size blank at the preliminary stage.

Final supplement, Registration no. 333-288196: "$1,500,000,000 / State Street Corporation / $800,000,000 Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2032 / $700,000,000 Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2037". "This is an offering of $800,000,000 aggregate principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2032 ... and $700,000,000 aggregate principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2037 ... of State Street Corporation." Fixed 4.558% then SOFR+0.914% (2032s) and 5.094% then SOFR+1.201% (2037s); unsecured senior debt, no conversion feature.

signals.thesis: Repli propre avant la décision de taux : −2,71 % lundi, −3,14 % sur cinq séances, RSI descendu à 47,7 et cours revenu à 1,84 % de sa moyenne mobile 50. Le titre reste 19,66 % au-dessus de sa moyenne 200 exponentielle — on achète un creux dans une tendance, pas un couteau qui tombe. La cible à 195,18 dollars est une résistance observée et sort à 1,13 de rapport gain/risque, le deuxième meilleur du panier. Sur le bilan, la conclusion est nette mais sa portée doit l'être aussi : aucun des quatre suppléments de la fenêtre ne crée d'actions ordinaires — 1,5 milliard de dollars d'obligations senior en avril, puis 500 millions de préférentielles perpétuelles non cumulatives à 6,350 % en août, ni l'une ni l'autre convertible. En revanche, la déclaration de base dont ils sont tirés, du 20 juin 2025, est une étagère automatique d'émetteur chevronné : elle est antérieure à la fenêtre de contrôle et couvre aussi les actions ordinaires. Comme pour Roivant, une émission reste possible sans préavis.

classification_evidence.decision: Dilution-clear. The 2026-07-16 S-8 primary (forms-8.htm) registers 8,500,000 shares solely for issuance under two shareholder-approved compensation plans; the document contains no reoffer/resale prospectus, no selling-securityholder section, and no 'use of proceeds' or underwriting language whatsoever (grep for proceeds/selling securityholder/reoffer/resale/underwrit over the full extracted text: zero hits), so there is no primary offering for issuer cash proceeds. I enumerated every Fastenal filing on EDGAR between 2026-03-18 and 2026-09-14 via the submissions API (29 filings): no S-1, no S-3, no S-3ASR, no 424B of any kind, no ATM prospectus supplement, no warrant or convertible issuance. The only capital-structure event in the window is the 2026-06-23 8-K (accession 0000815556-26-000035, items 1.01/2.03), which is pure debt: 'Fastenal Company ... entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement ... (i) renew its revolving credit commitment ... in the aggregate amount of $835,000,000' plus an amendment to its Master Note Agreement reducing capacity 'from an aggregate principal amount of up to $900 million to $600 million' of 'senior promissory notes' placed privately with insurance purchasers — no common-equity capacity and no conversion feature. Fastenal also has no live common-equity shelf in the recent record. FAST passes the dilution gate.
